title: Notification No. A.1307/1979 dated 07/08/2026, regarding appointment to the post of Registrar (Legal, Law & Inquiry), High Court of Gujarat, Ahmedabad.
text:
KEY LINES:
with effect from 17/08/2026.

FULL TEXT:
No. A.1307/1979
NOTIFICATION
The Honourable Chief Justice, High Court of Gujarat, Ahmedabad has been
pleased to appoint Mr. M. B. Rathore, Additional Registrar (Judicial), High Court of
Gujarat, as Registrar (Legal, Law & Inquiry), High Court of Gujarat, Ahmedabad,
with effect from 17/08/2026.
By order of the Honourable Chief
Justice of the High Court of Gujarat.

Ahmedabad - 380 060.
